papers.title: MoRAX: Mobility-based Representation Augmentation for Geospatial Foundation Models
papers.title_zh: MoRAX：基于移动性的地理空间基础模型表示增强
papers.reason: 该研究直接针对地理空间基础模型（GFM）中人类活动信息缺失的问题，提出利用人类移动数据增强地理空间嵌入，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘的研究方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) are emerging as a powerful paradigm for learning semantically rich and geographically consistent visual and physical representations. However, their reliance on Earth-observation (EO) data leaves information about human activity largely underrepresented. Human mobility data reveals the functional and relational structure between regions that is missing from EO data, but is often limited only to the city where it is observed, making it challenging to use for transferable urban representation learning. We introduce MoRAX, a lightweight framework for augmenting geospatial embeddings with functional structure derived from human mobility. MoRAX preserves the coverage and consistency of a GFM while providing information about the functional connectivity among urban regions, permitting zero-shot deployment in unseen cities with or without available mobility data. Across four target cities spanning two countries, the MoRAX teacher model, which observes mobility, consistently outperforms GFMs and strong urban representation baselines in eight socioeconomic and environmental prediction tasks. Meanwhile, the student model, which never takes mobility data as input, approaches the teacher in performance on most tasks. Transfer results across countries further demonstrate that modulation conditioned on mobility flows provides a general mechanism for grounding geospatial foundations in the human dimension of cities.
papers.summary_zh: MoRAX是一个轻量级框架，通过人类移动性数据增强地理空间嵌入，以补充地球观测数据中缺失的人类活动功能结构信息。该框架在保留GFM覆盖范围和一致性的同时，提供城市区域间的功能连接信息，支持在未见过的城市中进行零样本部署。在四个目标城市的八项社会经济和环境预测任务中，观察移动性的教师模型持续优于GFM和强基线，而学生模型在多数任务上接近教师模型性能。
papers.insight_zh: 人类移动性数据所蕴含的功能连接结构，可以作为地理空间基础模型的有效补充信号，提升模型对城市社会经济属性的预测能力，并具备跨城市泛化的潜力。

papers.title: To Remove or Not to Remove Clouds: A Comparative Analysis and Fusion of Raw SAR and Synthetic NDWI for Overcast Water Segmentation
papers.title_zh: 去除还是不去除云层：阴天水体分割中原始SAR与合成NDWI的比较与融合
papers.reason: 该研究直接针对多云条件下遥感水体分割问题，融合SAR和合成光学指数，是遥感变化检测和多源数据融合的典型应用，与城市更新中的洪涝监测高度相关。
papers.abstract: Persistent clouds blind optical satellites during floods. While Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) penetrates clouds, its raw data is noisy and lacks clear contrast. To mitigate this, recent studies utilize deep learning models to translate SAR into cloud-free synthetic optical imagery for downstream tasks like water body segmentation. However, because raw SAR is the original source for both of these operations, a critical methodological dilemma arises: during complete overcast should segmentation models process the raw SAR directly, or rely on a translated synthetic Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) proxy? This study resolves the debate by demonstrating that synthetic NDWI yields better results, as the translation process acts as a powerful filter against radar noise. This raises a natural second question: what if we utilize both? Building on our findings, we introduce a Combined Framework that integrates both raw SAR and synthetic NDWI into a unified model. By fusing the sharp physical boundaries of raw SAR with the high contrast of synthetic NDWI, this hybrid approach consistently outperforms all standalone methods.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了在完全阴天条件下，直接使用原始SAR数据与使用翻译后的合成NDWI进行水体分割的性能，发现合成NDWI效果更好，并进一步提出融合两者的框架，性能优于任何单一方法。
papers.insight_zh: 将原始SAR的物理边界与合成光学指数的高对比度融合，可有效克服雷达噪声，为多云地区的城市洪涝监测提供了更稳健的技术路径。

papers.title: Exploring Efficient Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in the Remote Sensing
papers.title_zh: 探索遥感中的高效开放词汇分割
papers.reason: 该研究聚焦遥感领域的开放词汇分割，是遥感影像智能解译的前沿方向，与遥感变化检测和地理空间智能高度相关。
papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨了遥感影像中开放词汇分割的高效方法，旨在利用视觉-语言模型实现对未见类别的分割，提升遥感影像分析的泛化能力。
papers.insight_zh: 开放词汇分割有望减少对标注数据的依赖，提高遥感影像分析模型在动态城市环境中的适应性和可扩展性。

papers.title: MoRA: Mobility as the Backbone for Geospatial Representation Learning at Scale
papers.title_zh: MoRA：以移动性为骨干的大规模地理空间表示学习
papers.reason: 该研究以移动性数据作为地理空间表示学习的主干，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘方向高度相关，且与MoRAX研究形成互补。
papers.summary_zh: 该论文摘要内容不完整，但根据标题推断，其核心思想是将人类移动性数据作为地理空间表示学习的主要数据源，旨在大规模地学习城市功能结构等地理空间特征。
papers.insight_zh: 移动性数据有望成为地理空间基础模型的核心数据模态之一，用于学习反映城市功能与人类活动的空间表示。

papers.title: Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with a Physics-Informed World Model for Cooperative Mixed Traffic Control
papers.title_zh: 基于物理信息世界模型的离线多智能体强化学习用于合作混合交通控制
papers.reason: 该论文研究混合交通中CAV的离线多智能体强化学习，结合物理信息世界模型，与GIS中的交通流模拟、智能交通系统及多智能体控制高度相关。
papers.abstract: This study investigates cooperative control of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) at partially observable highway bottlenecks in mixed traffic, aiming to mitigate congestion without relying on complete global traffic states or online trial-and-error. We propose a physics-informed world model-based offline multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that reconstructs a physically interpretable global traffic state from local CAV observation-action histories, with coupled macroscopic-microscopic traffic dynamics providing physics-based supervision. A probabilistic ensemble world model learns traffic-state transitions and system rewards, while model disagreement quantifies epistemic uncertainty. Multi-step imagined rollouts with pessimistic rewards and uncertainty-driven truncation are then used for offline policy learning. Experiments in a SUMO-based on-ramp bottleneck using approximately $1\times10^6$ offline transitions show that physics supervision improves state reconstruction and world-model prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出一种物理信息世界模型驱动的离线多智能体强化学习框架，用于部分可观测高速公路瓶颈处的CAV合作控制。通过耦合宏观-微观交通动力学提供物理监督，重建全局交通状态，并利用概率集成世界模型进行多步想象 rollout 和悲观奖励的离线策略学习。在SUMO仿真中，物理监督提升了状态重建和世界模型预测精度。
papers.insight_zh: 物理信息监督可显著提升世界模型的状态重建能力，这为离线多智能体强化学习在真实交通控制中的应用提供了可行路径。

papers.title: General Semantic Knowledge Infusion for Spatio-Temporal Traffic Forecasting
papers.title_zh: 面向时空交通预测的通用语义知识注入
papers.reason: 该研究将通用知识图谱（如Wikidata）的语义信息融入时空交通预测模型，通过数据融合增强GNN的上下文理解，与多源数据融合的研究方向紧密相关。
papers.abstract: Although Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have made significant advances in spatio-temporal traffic forecasting, their performance is limited when they rely solely on sensor proximity or road-network topology. This paper presents a spatio-temporal prediction framework, developed to incorporate knowledge in various forms. This framework aims to improve sensor-level, contextual understanding of the environment. A general-purpose knowledge graph (e.g., Wikidata) is used to create semantic subgraphs around traffic sensors and generate knowledge graph embeddings that capture meaningful relationships, such as nearby points of interest, administrative hierarchies, and the functional roles of locations. These embeddings are then fused with conventional traffic sensor graphs to provide additional adjacency matrices informed by semantics. This allows GNNs to learn the semantic context beyond physical connectivity. This study differs from previous research in two key ways. Firstly, rather than proposing a novel GNN architecture, it demonstrates the general impact of external knowledge on prediction accuracy. Secondly, experiments with well-established traffic forecasting approaches show that external knowledge provides additional information that street network data alone cannot convey. The results show that integrating data from general-purpose knowledge graphs and sensor networks through data fusion can enhance the prediction accuracy of traffic forecasting models, and offers a potential pathway toward improved interpretability.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出一个时空预测框架，将通用知识图谱（如Wikidata）生成的语义子图嵌入与传统的交通传感器图融合，为GNN提供超越物理连接性的语义上下文。实验表明，融合通用知识图谱和传感器网络数据能提升交通预测模型的准确性，并可能提高模型的可解释性。该研究不提出新的GNN架构，而是展示外部知识对预测精度的普遍影响。
papers.insight_zh: 通用知识图谱提供的语义信息（如兴趣点、行政层级、位置功能）是街道网络数据无法传达的补充信号，通过数据融合可有效提升交通预测性能。

papers.title: Proactive Road Safety Intervention in Australia: Predicting Risky Driving Hotspots from Connected Vehicle Data
papers.title_zh: 澳大利亚主动式道路安全干预：基于车联网数据预测危险驾驶热点
papers.reason: 该研究利用车联网遥测数据预测高风险驾驶热点，属于城市尺度时空数据挖掘与预测，与城市更新中的安全监测和智能决策高度相关。
papers.abstract: Road safety monitoring has historically been reactive, relying on crash-record analysis after fatalities and injuries have already occurred. Proactive identification of high-risk locations and dangerous driving behaviour before incidents occur is a critical but underexplored challenge. This paper addresses this gap using connected vehicle telemetry data from Greater Sydney, Australia, to detect and forecast near-miss risky driving events at the Local Government Area (LGA) level. Risky driving is quantified through g-force thresholds (hard braking >0.6g, harsh cornering >0.47g, harsh acceleration >0.5g), and spatio-temporal heatmaps are constructed to identify high-risk zones. Eight predictive models are benchmarked across three families: ensemble learning (Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM), deep learning (LSTM, N-BEATS), and classical time-series methods (ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing, Prophet). ARIMA achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE: 162.21), performing comparably to LSTM (MAE: 163.92) and outperforming all ensemble methods, with N-BEATS reaching an MAE of 180.75. These results demonstrate that parsimonious time-series models are competitive with deep learning approaches when training data volume is limited. The study highlights the potential of IoT-based connected vehicle data to support proactive road safety interventions, with Sydney's inner and western LGAs (CBD, Parramatta, Bankstown) identified as persistent high-risk zones warranting targeted policy action.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用澳大利亚大悉尼地区的车联网遥测数据，通过g力阈值识别危险驾驶事件，构建时空热力图，并对比了集成学习、深度学习和经典时间序列模型在地方政府区域级别的预测性能。结果显示ARIMA模型表现最佳，与LSTM相当，优于集成方法。
papers.insight_zh: 在数据量有限的情况下，简约的时间序列模型在预测城市级风险事件方面可与深度学习模型竞争，提示在城市更新规划中可优先考虑可解释性强的基线模型。

papers.title: A Theoretical Framework for Parallel Lifelong MAPF Using Group Decentralized Planning
papers.title_zh: 基于分组去中心化规划的多智能体终身路径规划理论框架
papers.reason: 该论文研究终身多智能体路径规划（L-MAPF）问题，提出分组去中心化规划框架，与多智能体系统、交通流控制等GIS相关研究方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: In the Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (L-MAPF) problem, agents must repeatedly move from one destination to another while avoiding obstacles and inter-agent collisions. Widely regarded as one of the highest-performing solutions to this problem is the Rolling-Horizon Collision Resolution (RHCR) framework. However, commensurate with its quality solutions, it incurs a computational cost that limits its applicability to even modest agent counts. In this paper, leveraging theoretical methods from the Locally Interdependent Multi-Agent MDP literature, we first theoretically prove the near-optimality of RHCR in a discounted MDP formulation of the L-MAPF problem. Then, we leverage these results to naturally motivate an extended framework called Group Decentralized RHCR (GD-RHCR) which incorporates a group decentralized structure that partitions agents based on a transitive communication scheme and plans for each partition of agents in parallel. We show that both RHCR and GD-RHCR achieve similar exponentially close to optimal guarantees, establishing a theoretical duality between the time based restrictions performed by vanilla RHCR and the additional space based partitioning performed by GD-RHCR. Lastly, we show that across varying maps, GD-RHCR is able to attain high throughput that scales into higher agent counts while maintaining a significantly lower per plan cost.
papers.summary_zh: 本文针对L-MAPF问题，从理论上证明了滚动时域碰撞消解（RHCR）框架在折扣MDP下的近最优性，并据此提出分组去中心化RHCR（GD-RHCR）框架，通过传递通信方案对智能体进行分组并行规划。实验表明，GD-RHCR在保持近最优保证的同时，显著降低了规划成本并支持更高智能体数量。
papers.insight_zh: 时间限制与空间分组在理论上具有对偶性，这为大规模多智能体路径规划提供了新的理论视角，可应用于城市交通流模拟与优化。

papers.title: Evaluating and improving crop-yield forecasting methods during extreme drought
papers.title_zh: 极端干旱期间作物产量预测方法的评估与改进
papers.reason: 该研究评估和改进了极端干旱条件下的作物产量预测模型，涉及机器学习、时空数据和气候驱动因素，与农业遥感和环境预测相关，但非城市更新核心。
papers.abstract: The impact of climate variability on food production has led to the creation of various forecasting models that uses machine learning (ML), numerical weather predictors (NWP) or a hybrid of ML-NWP models to identify structural and physical relationships between meteorological drivers and crop growth, in order to predict crop yield. Droughts, for example the 2012 Midwestern US (Corn Belt) drought, are extreme events that affect crop production and test the limits of these forecasting models. Using 16 meteorological drivers as predictors, we compare ML (non-deep learning) and deep learning forecasting models to predict the county-level corn yield for the extreme drought year, 2012. This forecasting problem is characterized by a dissimilarity between the feature distributions of the training and test data, where the meteorological conditions of the extreme drought year fall outside the range of historically observed values. Additionally, the dataset consists of spatial and temporal irregularities where counties with missing yields introduce spatial sparsity and the use of only a subset of daily values per year introduce temporal sparsity. To overcome this, we use sample weighting and feature selection as modifications to improve our forecasting models. These modifications lead to an improvement for ML models; however, the deep learning model VITA shows little to no improvement. While VITA outperforms the ML models with or without modifications, our current study sheds light on the effect of dissimilarity between train and test feature distributions on forecasting models, compares deep learning versus non-deep learning models, and introduces modifications that are effective for non-deep learning models.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究比较了机器学习（非深度学习）和深度学习模型在预测极端干旱年（2012年美国中西部）县级玉米产量时的表现。研究发现，训练和测试数据特征分布的不相似性对模型构成挑战。通过样本加权和特征选择等修改，机器学习模型的性能得到提升，但深度学习模型VITA改进甚微。尽管如此，VITA在有无修改的情况下均优于机器学习模型。
papers.insight_zh: 在极端事件预测中，训练与测试数据分布的不相似性是影响模型性能的关键因素，针对非深度学习模型的修改（如样本加权）可能有效，但深度学习模型对此类修改的响应不同。

papers.title: The Curious Case of Exploding DecPOMDPs: Containing the Fire through Policy Counting
papers.title_zh: 爆炸性DecPOMDP的奇特案例：通过策略计数控制火势
papers.reason: 该论文研究DecPOMDP中通过策略计数实现多智能体决策的可扩展性，与多智能体强化学习和分布式决策相关，对地理空间多智能体建模有理论价值。
papers.abstract: Decentralised partially observable Markov decision processes (DecPOMDPs) provide a general framework for modelling multi-agent decision making under uncertainty. However, DecPOMDPs are known to suffer from exponential complexity in the number of agents. One way to combat this intractability in agent numbers is to look at partitions of agents that exhibit a form of symmetry among agents, allowing for a compact encoding by counting. However, a challenge arises as the policy space explodes, even though the model complexity and evaluation cost reduce to a polynomial dependence. In this paper, we redirect our focus from counting agents to counting policies, which actually enables tractability in agent numbers for so called policy-counted DecPOMDPs. Further, we present policy-counted dynamic programming using the compact representation to solve policy-counted DecPOMDPs efficiently.
papers.summary_zh: 本文针对DecPOMDP中智能体数量指数级复杂性问题，提出从计数智能体转向计数策略，实现策略计数的DecPOMDP，并设计策略计数动态规划算法，利用紧凑表示高效求解。
papers.insight_zh: 通过计数策略而非智能体，可在保持模型紧凑性的同时实现多智能体决策的可扩展性，为大规模地理空间多智能体规划提供了新思路。
